title: Tech Lead / Staff Engineer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Tech Lead / Staff Engineer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas
lines: 1. Architectural Leadership: Defining multi-system technical architecture, evaluating build vs buy, and de-risking high-complexity technical roadmaps.
2. Technical Strategy & Vision: Setting 1-3 year technical trajectories, simplifying complex monolithic architectures into scalable domains, and preventing technical debt.
3. Cross-Functional Influence & Alignment: Partnering with Product, Design, and Executive stakeholders, writing comprehensive RFCs, and driving consensus without formal authority.
4. Mentorship & Multiplier Effect: Elevating senior and mid-level engineers, establishing engineering quality standards, and scaling team capabilities.

sections.heading: Question Strategy & Guidance
lines: - PREFER BRIEF PILLARS: Deep dive into the candidate's stated multi-team initiatives, high-stakes trade-off decisions, and architecture proposals.
- Probe organizational influence, handling technical disagreements with other principal engineers, and navigating ambiguous business mandates.
